title: South Korea Leads The World In Factory Robots
hook: The robot capital is not the country installing the most machines.
closing: Automation leadership is about robots per worker, and South Korea dominates that measure.
question: Would a robot coworker worry you?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 robots per ten thousand factory workers. No other country comes close.
The United States has 307 robots per ten thousand workers. That makes South Korea's lead nearly fourfold.
China has 166 robots per ten thousand workers. Huge installations still leave it far behind South Korea's density.
